setups.description: BASS-II two-sided flat PMMA specimens in the ISS Microgravity Science Glovebox duct.

calibrations.source_locator: NASA/TM-20210011385, section 2.3, Eq. 2.11 and Eq. 2.12. F=4.76 is calibrated to the 100 um PMMA point.

spread_rate_checks.measurement_basis: Approximate value digitized visually from Fig. 2.21. Its individual airflow is not specified in that plot, so this is a thin-limit thickness check.
spread_rate_checks.source_locator: Fig. 2.20(b) run ID and Fig. 2.21 microgravity series.

spread_rate_checks.measurement_basis: Approximate value digitized visually from Fig. 2.21. Its individual airflow is not specified in that plot, so this is a thin-limit thickness check.
spread_rate_checks.source_locator: Fig. 2.20(c) run ID and Fig. 2.21 microgravity series.

notes: The 3 cm/s profile speed is the explicitly documented thin-sheet comparison speed in Fig. 2.19. The two other thickness checks are approximate graph reads, with unspecified flow in that figure. The plotted oxygen legend rounds the 20.7% cited in Fig. 2.20 to 21%.
Only the thermally thin branch has an ISS data check in this example. For other materials or thick fuel, supply appropriate properties and a supported envelope.
